name: Israel Ilori
title: Senior Data & AI Engineer
description: Israel Ilori is a Senior Data & AI Engineer in Vancouver building data platforms and production machine learning systems.
intro: I build data platforms and production machine learning systems. Over eight years I've worked across advertising, the public sector, finance and technology, and the part I enjoy most is turning a loosely defined business question into a system people can rely on.
about: Right now I work in Ads Intelligence at Aylo, where I build click-prediction models, run our ML services on Kubernetes, and am designing a bid recommendation system. Before that I led a data management platform at the BC Public Service that brought C$1.5 billion in telecom spend across thirteen public-sector entities into one governed view.

Earlier I trained transformer models for threat and misinformation detection at Logically, built search and data pipelines at HelpSeeker, and started out as a data analyst in banking. I hold an M.Sc. in Data Science from the University of Manchester, and in January 2027 I start the Professional MBA at UBC Sauder, because the problems I care about most are now as much about strategy and teams as about technology.

experience.summary: Click-prediction models on billions of ad impressions, ML services on Kubernetes with CI/CD and Prometheus/Jaeger observability, a bid recommendation system, an agentic AI MVP, an image-understanding service, and a ClickHouse schema migration across distributed tables.
Led the Data Management Platform for telecom spend across 13 entities. Event-driven ETL on AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Athena) with Terraform, and Power BI reporting for executive leadership.
Python ETL and Airflow pipelines for the Karto platform, and a document similarity model deployed on Kubernetes for search.
Led ML upgrades to the Logically Intelligence platform that raised threat-detection accuracy by 32%, rebuilt transformer classification pipelines, and ran MLOps on GCP.
Designed the NLP matching system that ranked candidates against job descriptions, working directly with the founders.
Dashboards for senior management in Tableau and Power BI, and financial trend analysis in Python and SQL.
